50 | The Sailing Master | caster | 10 min/lvl | self | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows caster to know his current location in the ocean to within ±d10 miles.
The caster can also tell which way is north.
@@ 2
Allows caster to determine the height of the tide, whether it is coming in or
going out, the maximum height (or depth) and the time it will reach apogee (or
perigee).
@@ 3
Allows the caster to determine the depth of the water within range at any
point. The information will include maximum, minimum, and average depth.
@@ 4
Caster can see 100’ on a clear night as if it were day. At least some residual
light is required for this spell to work.
@@ 5
This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal base movement rate
(i.e., as fast as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the
duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 6
This spell allows the caster to row at double normal rate, with no exhaustion
points spent, for the duration. If he stops rowing, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 7
This spell allows the caster to make no sound while rowing at the normal rate
for the duration (i.e., there will be no sound from the rowlocks nor from the
entry/exit of the oar into the water). If he stops rowing, the spell is
cancelled.
@@ 8
As Nightvision, except caster can see 100’ in any precipitation or gas.
@@ 9
This spell allows the caster to make no sound while swimming at normal rate,
and “camouflages” the caster against the water, making him difficult to spot
(-50 to Awareness maneuvers to notice the caster). If the caster stops
swimming, the spell is cancelled.
@@ 10
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all
Sailing maneuvers.
@@ 11
Caster may run on water (i.e., move at double his normal base pace) and will
expend exhaustion points as normal. GMs may require maneuver rolls if the
water is rough.
@@ 12
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all
Drafting, Mapping, and/ or Cartography maneuvers.
@@ 13
For the duration of this spell, the caster can see underwater to a distance of
10’/lvl (some residual light must be available). In addition, the caster may
also breathe water as well as air.
@@ 14
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all
Navigation maneuvers.
@@ 15
As Nightvision and Fogvision, except the caster’s range of vision is normal
daylight range (i.e., to the horizon).
@@ 16
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all
Boat Piloting maneuvers.
@@ 17
As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 18
As Forced Row, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 19
As Silent Row, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 20
As Ghost Swim, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 25
As Water Running, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 30
As Water Survival, except caster can affect one target per level.
@@ 50
For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +50 bonus to all
Sailing, Drafting, Mapping, Cartography, Navigation and Boat Pilot maneuvers.
